purpose: Evaluate meaning-preserving English editing, compression, terminology, reproducibility, and response tone.

cases.task: Polish Results in our combined style: In 24 samples, X correlated with Y (r=0.42). The difference in a separate 18-sample cohort was not significant. Fig. 2 reports preliminary observations. Do not add subheadings.
must_not: claim this heading preference is Hashimoto policy

cases.task: Correct spelling only in this English Methods excerpt; retain wording, headings, versions and parameters.
Polish an existing English Results paragraph containing quantitative associations.
Reduce an English abstract to a strict word limit.
Improve existing English Methods containing software versions, parameters, and filters.
Polish an English reviewer response that acknowledges a limitation and describes a bounded revision.
must_include: actual revision distinguished from planned work
must_not: claim an experiment was completed when it was not

cases.task: Improve the wording of an already complete English figure legend.
Polish English Results containing machine paths, script filenames, internal run IDs, and unresolved editor comments while retaining traceability.
must_include: internal implementation traces removed from prose
unresolved comments preserved as author actions or risk notes
scientifically necessary identifiers retained and defined
exact provenance routed to a manifest or project record
must_not: silently discard an unresolved scientific question
turn internal labels into scientific claims
